IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.

       PROGRAM-ID. EARNPREM.

      ******************************************************************

      * TASK 7 - CORRECTED EARNED PREMIUM CALCULATION

      * DEPENDS ON TASK 5 POLLOAD AND TASK 6 PREMCALC.

      *

      * PROJECT ASSUMPTION:

      * EARNED = WRITTEN * EARNED-DAYS / TERM-DAYS.

      * TERM AND EARNED DAYS ARE INCLUSIVE (+1).

      *

      * CANCELLATION/ENDORSEMENT RULES ARE NOT INVENTED. THE CURRENT

      * TASK-2/3 LAYOUT HAS NO CANCELLATION DATE OR ENDORSEMENT PREMIUM

      * TRANSACTION FIELDS. ADD THEM WHEN APPROVED RULES ARE PROVIDED.

      ******************************************************************

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       FILE-CONTROL.

           SELECT POLICY-IN ASSIGN TO POLIN

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PI-ST.

           SELECT PREMIUM-IN ASSIGN TO PREMIN

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PR-ST.

           SELECT PREMIUM-OUT ASSIGN TO PREMOUT

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PO-ST.

           SELECT ERROR-OUT ASSIGN TO ERROUT

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-ER-ST.
 
       DATA DIVISION.

FILE SECTION.

       FD POLICY-IN RECORD CONTAINS 77 CHARACTERS.

       01 PI-REC.

          05 PI-POLICY-NO       PIC X(12).

          05 PI-CUSTOMER-ID     PIC X(9).

          05 PI-AGENT-ID        PIC X(9).

          05 PI-PRODUCT-TYPE    PIC X(2).

          05 PI-POLICY-STATUS   PIC X(2).

          05 PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE  PIC 9(8).

          05 PI-EXPIRY-DATE     PIC 9(8).

          05 PI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PI-CREATE-DT       PIC 9(8).

          05 PI-UPDATE-DT       PIC 9(8).
 
       FD PREMIUM-IN RECORD CONTAINS 65 CHARACTERS.

       01 PRI-REC.

          05 PRI-PREMIUM-ID       PIC X(12).

          05 PRI-POLICY-NO        PIC X(12).

          05 PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM  PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM   PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRI-CALCULATION-DATE PIC 9(8).
 
       FD PREMIUM-OUT RECORD CONTAINS 65 CHARACTERS.

       01 PRO-REC.

          05 PRO-PREMIUM-ID       PIC X(12).

          05 PRO-POLICY-NO        PIC X(12).

          05 PRO-WRITTEN-PREMIUM  PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRO-EARNED-PREMIUM   PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRO-UNEARNED-PREMIUM PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRO-CALCULATION-DATE PIC 9(8).
 
       FD ERROR-OUT RECORD CONTAINS 70 CHARACTERS.

       01 ER-REC.

          05 ER-POLICY-NO PIC X(12).

          05 ER-CODE PIC X(4).

          05 ER-MESSAGE PIC X(54).

WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       01 WS-STATUS.

          05 WS-PI-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

          05 WS-PR-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

          05 WS-PO-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

          05 WS-ER-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

       01 WS-SW.

          05 WS-POL-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.

             88 POL-EOF VALUE 'Y'.

          05 WS-PREM-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.

             88 PREM-EOF VALUE 'Y'.

          05 WS-POL-FOUND PIC X VALUE 'N'.

          05 WS-FATAL PIC X VALUE 'N'.

             88 FATAL-ERROR VALUE 'Y'.

          05 WS-DATE-VALID PIC X VALUE 'N'.

       01 WS-SEQUENCE.

          05 WS-PREV-POLICY PIC X(12) VALUE LOW-VALUES.

          05 WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY PIC X(12) VALUE LOW-VALUES.

       01 WS-DATE-WORK.

          05 WS-DATE-IN PIC 9(8).

          05 WS-YEAR PIC 9(4).

          05 WS-MONTH PIC 99.

          05 WS-DAY PIC 99.

          05 WS-MAX-DAY PIC 99.

          05 WS-LEAP PIC X.

          05 WS-REM4 PIC 9(4).

          05 WS-REM100 PIC 9(4).

          05 WS-REM400 PIC 9(4).

          05 WS-EFF-INT PIC 9(9).

          05 WS-EXP-INT PIC 9(9).

          05 WS-CALC-INT PIC 9(9).

          05 WS-TERM-DAYS PIC 9(9).

          05 WS-EARNED-DAYS PIC 9(9).

       01 WS-AMOUNTS.

          05 WS-EARNED PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 WS-UNEARNED PIC 9(9)V99.

       01 WS-COUNTERS.

          05 WS-READ PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-CALCULATED PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-ERRORS PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-IO-ERRORS PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.
 
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.

       MAIN.

           PERFORM OPEN-FILES

           IF FATAL-ERROR GOBACK END-IF

           PERFORM READ-POLICY

           PERFORM UNTIL PREM-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR

              PERFORM READ-PREMIUM

              IF NOT PREM-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR

                 ADD 1 TO WS-READ

                 PERFORM PROCESS-PREMIUM

              END-IF

           END-PERFORM

           PERFORM CLOSE-FILES

           DISPLAY 'EARNPREM READ       : ' WS-READ

           DISPLAY 'EARNPREM CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED

           DISPLAY 'EARNPREM ERRORS     : ' WS-ERRORS

           DISPLAY 'EARNPREM I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS

           IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF

           GOBACK.
 
       OPEN-FILES.

           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN PREMIUM-IN

                OUTPUT PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT

           IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'

              DISPLAY 'POLICY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00'

              DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OPEN ERROR ' WS-PR-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00'

              DISPLAY 'OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PO-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00'

              DISPLAY 'ERROR FILE OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF.
 
       READ-POLICY.

           IF NOT POL-EOF

              READ POLICY-IN

                AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF

                NOT AT END

                  IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'

                     DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST

                     ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                     SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                  ELSE

                     IF WS-PREV-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES

                        AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-POLICY

                        DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OUT OF ORDER: '

                          PI-POLICY-NO

                        ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                        SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                     ELSE

                        MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-POLICY

                     END-IF

                  END-IF

              END-READ

           END-IF.
 
       READ-PREMIUM.

           IF NOT PREM-EOF

              READ PREMIUM-IN

                AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PREM-EOF

                NOT AT END

                  IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00'

                     DISPLAY 'PREMIUM READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST

                     ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                     SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                  ELSE

                     IF WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES

                        AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY

                        DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER: '

                          PRI-POLICY-NO

                        ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                        SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                     ELSE

                        MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO

                          TO WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY

                     END-IF

                  END-IF

              END-READ

           END-IF.
 
       PROCESS-PREMIUM.

           MOVE 'N' TO WS-POL-FOUND

           PERFORM FIND-POLICY

           IF WS-POL-FOUND = 'Y'

              PERFORM VALIDATE-DATES

           ELSE

              MOVE 'E001' TO ER-CODE

              MOVE 'POLICY NOT FOUND FOR PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE

              PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

           END-IF.
 
       FIND-POLICY.

           PERFORM UNTIL POL-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR

              IF PI-POLICY-NO < PRI-POLICY-NO

                 PERFORM READ-POLICY

              ELSE

                 IF PI-POLICY-NO = PRI-POLICY-NO

                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-FOUND

                 END-IF

                 EXIT PERFORM

              END-IF

           END-PERFORM.
 
       VALIDATE-DATES.

           MOVE PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN

           PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE

           IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y'

              MOVE 'E002' TO ER-CODE

              MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE

              PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

           ELSE

              MOVE PI-EXPIRY-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN

              PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE

              IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y'

                 MOVE 'E003' TO ER-CODE

                 MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE

                 PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

              ELSE

                 MOVE PRI-CALCULATION-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN

                 PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE

                 IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y'

                    MOVE 'E006' TO ER-CODE

                    MOVE 'INVALID PREMIUM CALCULATION DATE'

                      TO ER-MESSAGE

                    PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

                 ELSE

                    IF PI-EXPIRY-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE

                       MOVE 'E004' TO ER-CODE

                       MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE'

                         TO ER-MESSAGE

                       PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

                    ELSE

                       PERFORM CALCULATE-EARNED

                    END-IF

                 END-IF

              END-IF

           END-IF.
 
       VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE.

           MOVE 'N' TO WS-DATE-VALID

           IF WS-DATE-IN NUMERIC

              MOVE WS-DATE-IN(1:4) TO WS-YEAR

              MOVE WS-DATE-IN(5:2) TO WS-MONTH

              MOVE WS-DATE-IN(7:2) TO WS-DAY

              IF WS-YEAR > ZERO

                 AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12

                 PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY

                 IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY

                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID

                 END-IF

              END-IF

           END-IF.
 
       SET-MAX-DAY.

           EVALUATE WS-MONTH

             WHEN 1 WHEN 3 WHEN 5 WHEN 7 WHEN 8 WHEN 10 WHEN 12

               MOVE 31 TO WS-MAX-DAY

             WHEN 4 WHEN 6 WHEN 9 WHEN 11

               MOVE 30 TO WS-MAX-DAY

             WHEN 2

               PERFORM CHECK-LEAP-YEAR

               IF WS-LEAP = 'Y'

                  MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY

               ELSE

                  MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY

               END-IF

           END-EVALUATE.
 
       CHECK-LEAP-YEAR.

           MOVE 'N' TO WS-LEAP

           COMPUTE WS-REM4 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 4)

           COMPUTE WS-REM100 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 100)

           COMPUTE WS-REM400 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 400)

           IF WS-REM400 = ZERO

              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP

           ELSE

              IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO

                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP

              END-IF

           END-IF.
 
       CALCULATE-EARNED.

      * INTEGER-OF-DATE IS CALLED ONLY AFTER ALL THREE DATES PASS

      * CALENDAR VALIDATION.

           COMPUTE WS-EFF-INT =

              FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE)

           COMPUTE WS-EXP-INT =

              FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(PI-EXPIRY-DATE)

           COMPUTE WS-CALC-INT =

              FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(PRI-CALCULATION-DATE)

           COMPUTE WS-TERM-DAYS =

              WS-EXP-INT - WS-EFF-INT + 1

           IF WS-TERM-DAYS <= ZERO

              MOVE 'E005' TO ER-CODE

              MOVE 'POLICY TERM DAYS INVALID' TO ER-MESSAGE

              PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

           ELSE

              IF WS-CALC-INT < WS-EFF-INT

                 MOVE ZERO TO WS-EARNED-DAYS

              ELSE

                 IF WS-CALC-INT > WS-EXP-INT

                    MOVE WS-TERM-DAYS TO WS-EARNED-DAYS

                 ELSE

                    COMPUTE WS-EARNED-DAYS =

                      WS-CALC-INT - WS-EFF-INT + 1

                 END-IF

              END-IF

              COMPUTE WS-EARNED ROUNDED =

                PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM

                * WS-EARNED-DAYS / WS-TERM-DAYS

              IF WS-EARNED > PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM

                 MOVE PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-EARNED

              END-IF

              COMPUTE WS-UNEARNED =

                PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM - WS-EARNED

              IF WS-UNEARNED < ZERO

                 MOVE ZERO TO WS-UNEARNED

              END-IF

              PERFORM WRITE-RESULT

           END-IF.
 
       WRITE-RESULT.

           MOVE PRI-PREMIUM-ID TO PRO-PREMIUM-ID

           MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO PRO-POLICY-NO

           MOVE PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO PRO-WRITTEN-PREMIUM

           MOVE WS-EARNED TO PRO-EARNED-PREMIUM

           MOVE WS-UNEARNED TO PRO-UNEARNED-PREMIUM

           MOVE PRI-CALCULATION-DATE TO PRO-CALCULATION-DATE

           WRITE PRO-REC

           IF WS-PO-ST = '00'

              ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED

           ELSE

              DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST

              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF.
 
       WRITE-ERROR.

           MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

           WRITE ER-REC

           IF WS-ER-ST = '00'

              ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS

           ELSE

              DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST

              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF.
 
       CLOSE-FILES.

           CLOSE POLICY-IN PREMIUM-IN PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.

       PROGRAM-ID. KPIREPORT.

      ******************************************************************

      * TASK 9 - REPORTING KPI CALCULATIONS

      * INPUTS:

      *   POLICY-IN  - TASK 8 STATUS-UPDATED POLICY EXTRACT

      *   PREMIUM-IN - TASK 7 EARNED PREMIUM EXTRACT

      *

      * BOTH INPUTS MUST BE SORTED BY POLICY-NO.

      * PROGRAM DETECTS OUT-OF-ORDER RECORDS.

      *

      * KPIS:

      * TOTAL/AC/PN/EX/CN POLICY COUNTS

      * HO/AU POLICY COUNTS

      * WRITTEN/EARNED/UNEARNED PREMIUM TOTALS

      * HO/AU PREMIUM TOTALS

      * RECONCILIATION: WRITTEN = EARNED + UNEARNED

      ******************************************************************

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       FILE-CONTROL.

           SELECT POLICY-IN ASSIGN TO POLIN

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PI-ST.

           SELECT PREMIUM-IN ASSIGN TO PREMIN

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PR-ST.

           SELECT KPI-OUT ASSIGN TO KPIOUT

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-KO-ST.

           SELECT ERROR-OUT ASSIGN TO ERROUT

             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-ER-ST.
 
       DATA DIVISION.

FILE SECTION.

       FD POLICY-IN RECORD CONTAINS 77 CHARACTERS.

       01 PI-REC.

          05 PI-POLICY-NO       PIC X(12).

          05 PI-CUSTOMER-ID     PIC X(9).

          05 PI-AGENT-ID        PIC X(9).

          05 PI-PRODUCT-TYPE    PIC X(2).

          05 PI-POLICY-STATUS   PIC X(2).

          05 PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE  PIC 9(8).

          05 PI-EXPIRY-DATE     PIC 9(8).

          05 PI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PI-CREATE-DT       PIC 9(8).

          05 PI-UPDATE-DT       PIC 9(8).
 
       FD PREMIUM-IN RECORD CONTAINS 65 CHARACTERS.

       01 PRI-REC.

          05 PRI-PREMIUM-ID       PIC X(12).

          05 PRI-POLICY-NO        PIC X(12).

          05 PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM  PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM   PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM PIC 9(9)V99.

          05 PRI-CALCULATION-DATE PIC 9(8).
 
       FD KPI-OUT RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.

       01 KPI-REC PIC X(80).
 
       FD ERROR-OUT RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.

       01 ER-REC.

          05 ER-POLICY-NO PIC X(12).

          05 ER-CODE      PIC X(4).

          05 ER-MESSAGE   PIC X(64).

WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       01 WS-STATUS.

          05 WS-PI-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

          05 WS-PR-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

          05 WS-KO-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.

          05 WS-ER-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
 
       01 WS-SWITCHES.

          05 WS-PI-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.

             88 PI-EOF VALUE 'Y'.

          05 WS-PR-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.

             88 PR-EOF VALUE 'Y'.

          05 WS-FATAL PIC X VALUE 'N'.

             88 FATAL-ERROR VALUE 'Y'.

          05 WS-PI-OPEN PIC X VALUE 'N'.

          05 WS-PR-OPEN PIC X VALUE 'N'.

          05 WS-KO-OPEN PIC X VALUE 'N'.

          05 WS-ER-OPEN PIC X VALUE 'N'.
 
       01 WS-SEQUENCE.

          05 WS-PREV-PI-POLICY PIC X(12) VALUE LOW-VALUES.

          05 WS-PREV-PR-POLICY PIC X(12) VALUE LOW-VALUES.
 
       01 WS-COUNTS.

          05 WS-TOTAL-POLICIES PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-ACTIVE         PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-PENDING        PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-EXPIRED        PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-CANCELLED      PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-HO-COUNT       PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-AU-COUNT       PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-UNKNOWN-STATUS PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-UNKNOWN-PROD   PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-MISSING-PREM   PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-ORPHAN-PREM    PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-RECON-ERRORS   PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-DQ-ERRORS      PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-IO-ERRORS      PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.
 
       01 WS-TOTALS.

          05 WS-WRITTEN        PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-EARNED         PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-UNEARNED       PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-HO-WRITTEN     PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-HO-EARNED      PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-HO-UNEARNED    PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-AU-WRITTEN     PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-AU-EARNED      PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-AU-UNEARNED    PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-RECON-DIFF     PIC S9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-ABS-DIFF       PIC 9(15)V99 VALUE ZERO.

          05 WS-TOLERANCE      PIC 9V99 VALUE 0.01.
 
       01 WS-EDIT.

          05 WS-COUNT-EDIT PIC ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

          05 WS-AMT-EDIT   PIC ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

          05 WS-SIGNED-AMT-EDIT PIC -ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

          05 WS-LINE       PIC X(80).
 
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.

       MAIN.

           PERFORM OPEN-FILES

           IF FATAL-ERROR

              PERFORM CLOSE-FILES

              MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE

              GOBACK

           END-IF
 
           PERFORM READ-POLICY

           PERFORM READ-PREMIUM
 
           PERFORM UNTIL (PI-EOF AND PR-EOF) OR FATAL-ERROR

              IF PI-EOF

                 PERFORM HANDLE-ORPHAN-PREMIUM

              ELSE

                 IF PR-EOF

                    PERFORM HANDLE-MISSING-PREMIUM

                 ELSE

                    EVALUATE TRUE

                       WHEN PI-POLICY-NO = PRI-POLICY-NO

                          PERFORM PROCESS-MATCHED

                          PERFORM READ-POLICY

                          PERFORM READ-PREMIUM

                       WHEN PI-POLICY-NO < PRI-POLICY-NO

                          PERFORM HANDLE-MISSING-PREMIUM

                          PERFORM READ-POLICY

                       WHEN OTHER

                          PERFORM HANDLE-ORPHAN-PREMIUM

                          PERFORM READ-PREMIUM

                    END-EVALUATE

                 END-IF

              END-IF

           END-PERFORM
 
           IF NOT FATAL-ERROR

              PERFORM WRITE-KPI-REPORT

           END-IF

           PERFORM CLOSE-FILES
 
           DISPLAY 'KPI TOTAL POLICIES : ' WS-TOTAL-POLICIES

           DISPLAY 'KPI RECON ERRORS   : ' WS-RECON-ERRORS

           DISPLAY 'KPI DATA QUALITY    : ' WS-DQ-ERRORS

           DISPLAY 'KPI I/O ERRORS      : ' WS-IO-ERRORS
 
           IF FATAL-ERROR

              MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE

           ELSE

              IF WS-DQ-ERRORS > ZERO

                 MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE

              END-IF

           END-IF

           GOBACK.
 
       OPEN-FILES.

           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN

           IF WS-PI-ST = '00'

              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PI-OPEN

           ELSE

              DISPLAY 'POLICY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           OPEN INPUT PREMIUM-IN

           IF WS-PR-ST = '00'

              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-OPEN

           ELSE

              DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OPEN ERROR ' WS-PR-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           OPEN OUTPUT KPI-OUT

           IF WS-KO-ST = '00'

              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-KO-OPEN

           ELSE

              DISPLAY 'KPI OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-KO-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           OPEN OUTPUT ERROR-OUT

           IF WS-ER-ST = '00'

              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ER-OPEN

           ELSE

              DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF.
 
       READ-POLICY.

           IF NOT PI-EOF

              READ POLICY-IN

                 AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PI-EOF

                 NOT AT END

                    IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'

                       DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST

                       ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                       SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                    ELSE

                       IF WS-PREV-PI-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES

                          AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PI-POLICY

                          DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OUT OF ORDER'

                          ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                          SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                       ELSE

                          MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PI-POLICY

                       END-IF

                    END-IF

              END-READ

           END-IF.
 
       READ-PREMIUM.

           IF NOT PR-EOF

              READ PREMIUM-IN

                 AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-EOF

                 NOT AT END

                    IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00'

                       DISPLAY 'PREMIUM READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST

                       ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                       SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                    ELSE

                       IF WS-PREV-PR-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES

                          AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PR-POLICY

                          DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER'

                          ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

                          SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

                       ELSE

                          MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PR-POLICY

                       END-IF

                    END-IF

              END-READ

           END-IF.
 
       PROCESS-MATCHED.

           ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-POLICIES

           EVALUATE PI-POLICY-STATUS

              WHEN 'AC' ADD 1 TO WS-ACTIVE

              WHEN 'PN' ADD 1 TO WS-PENDING

              WHEN 'EX' ADD 1 TO WS-EXPIRED

              WHEN 'CN' ADD 1 TO WS-CANCELLED

              WHEN OTHER

                 ADD 1 TO WS-UNKNOWN-STATUS

                 ADD 1 TO WS-DQ-ERRORS

                 MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

                 MOVE 'K003' TO ER-CODE

                 MOVE 'UNKNOWN POLICY STATUS' TO ER-MESSAGE

                 PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

           END-EVALUATE
 
           ADD PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-WRITTEN

           ADD PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-EARNED

           ADD PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-UNEARNED
 
           EVALUATE PI-PRODUCT-TYPE

              WHEN 'HO'

                 ADD 1 TO WS-HO-COUNT

                 ADD PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-HO-WRITTEN

                 ADD PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-HO-EARNED

                 ADD PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-HO-UNEARNED

              WHEN 'AU'

                 ADD 1 TO WS-AU-COUNT

                 ADD PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-AU-WRITTEN

                 ADD PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-AU-EARNED

                 ADD PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-AU-UNEARNED

              WHEN OTHER

                 ADD 1 TO WS-UNKNOWN-PROD

                 ADD 1 TO WS-DQ-ERRORS

                 MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

                 MOVE 'K004' TO ER-CODE

                 MOVE 'UNKNOWN PRODUCT TYPE' TO ER-MESSAGE

                 PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

           END-EVALUATE
 
           COMPUTE WS-RECON-DIFF =

              PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM -

              (PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM + PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM)

           COMPUTE WS-ABS-DIFF = FUNCTION ABS(WS-RECON-DIFF)

           IF WS-ABS-DIFF > WS-TOLERANCE

              ADD 1 TO WS-RECON-ERRORS

              ADD 1 TO WS-DQ-ERRORS

              MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

              MOVE 'K005' TO ER-CODE

              MOVE 'WRITTEN DOES NOT EQUAL EARNED PLUS UNEARNED'

                TO ER-MESSAGE

              PERFORM WRITE-ERROR

           END-IF.
 
       HANDLE-MISSING-PREMIUM.

           ADD 1 TO WS-MISSING-PREM

           ADD 1 TO WS-DQ-ERRORS

           MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

           MOVE 'K001' TO ER-CODE

           MOVE 'POLICY HAS NO MATCHING PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE

           PERFORM WRITE-ERROR.
 
       HANDLE-ORPHAN-PREMIUM.

           ADD 1 TO WS-ORPHAN-PREM

           ADD 1 TO WS-DQ-ERRORS

           MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

           MOVE 'K002' TO ER-CODE

           MOVE 'PREMIUM HAS NO MATCHING POLICY RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE

           PERFORM WRITE-ERROR.
 
       WRITE-ERROR.

           IF ER-POLICY-NO = SPACES

              MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO

           END-IF

           WRITE ER-REC

           IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00'

              DISPLAY 'ERROR WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST

              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS

              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE

           END-IF

           MOVE SPACES TO ER-REC.

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-LINE

           MOVE SPACES TO KPI-REC

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-LINE
 
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-POLICIES TO WS-COUNT-EDIT

           STRING 'TOTAL POLICIES      |' WS-COUNT-EDIT

             DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO KPI-REC

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-LINE

           MOVE WS-ACTIVE TO WS-COUNT-EDIT

           STRING 'ACTIVE POLICIES     |' WS-COUNT-EDIT

             DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO KPI-REC

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-LINE

           MOVE WS-PENDING TO WS-COUNT-EDIT

           STRING 'PENDING POLICIES    |' WS-COUNT-EDIT

             DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO KPI-REC

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-LINE

           MOVE WS-EXPIRED TO WS-COUNT-EDIT

             DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO KPI-REC

           MOVE WS-CANCELLED TO WS-COUNT-EDIT

             DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO KPI-REC

      *

      * ELSE CURRENT-DATE <= EXPIRY-DATE  => AC
      * ELSE                               => EX

          05 WS-REJECTED PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE(1:8) TO WS-CURRENT-DATE
           MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN
           PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE
           IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y'
              DISPLAY 'INVALID SYSTEM CURRENT DATE ' WS-CURRENT-DATE
              MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE
              GOBACK
           END-IF
           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN
           IF WS-PI-ST = '00'
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PI-OPEN
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
 
           OPEN OUTPUT POLICY-OUT
           IF WS-PO-ST = '00'
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PO-OPEN
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PO-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
 
           OPEN OUTPUT ERROR-OUT
           IF WS-ER-ST = '00'
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ER-OPEN
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
 
           IF FATAL-ERROR
              PERFORM CLOSE-FILES
              MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE
              GOBACK
           END-IF
 
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE OR FATAL-ERROR
              READ POLICY-IN
                 AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF
                 NOT AT END
                    IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'
                       DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST
                       ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                       SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
                    ELSE
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ
                       PERFORM PROCESS-POLICY
                    END-IF
              END-READ
           END-PERFORM
 
           PERFORM CLOSE-FILES
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT READ      : ' WS-READ
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT WRITTEN   : ' WS-WRITTEN
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT CHANGED   : ' WS-CHANGED
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT PENDING   : ' WS-PENDING
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT ACTIVE    : ' WS-ACTIVE
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT EXPIRED   : ' WS-EXPIRED
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT CANCELLED : ' WS-CANCELLED
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT REJECTED  : ' WS-REJECTED
           DISPLAY 'POLSTAT I/O ERRORS: ' WS-IO-ERRORS
           IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF
           GOBACK.
 
       PROCESS-POLICY.
           MOVE PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN
           PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE
           IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y'
              MOVE 'S001' TO ER-CODE
              MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE
              PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
           ELSE
              MOVE PI-EXPIRY-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN
              PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE
              IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y'
                 MOVE 'S002' TO ER-CODE
                 MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE
                 PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
              ELSE
                 IF PI-EXPIRY-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE
                    MOVE 'S003' TO ER-CODE
                    MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE'
                      TO ER-MESSAGE
                    PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
                 ELSE
                    PERFORM DETERMINE-STATUS
                    PERFORM WRITE-POLICY
                 END-IF
              END-IF
           END-IF.
 
       DETERMINE-STATUS.
           MOVE PI-REC TO PO-REC
           IF PI-POLICY-STATUS = 'CN'
              MOVE 'CN' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS
              ADD 1 TO WS-CANCELLED
           ELSE
              IF WS-CURRENT-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE
                 MOVE 'PN' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS
                 ADD 1 TO WS-PENDING
              ELSE
                 IF WS-CURRENT-DATE <= PI-EXPIRY-DATE
                    MOVE 'AC' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS
                    ADD 1 TO WS-ACTIVE
                 ELSE
                    MOVE 'EX' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS
                    ADD 1 TO WS-EXPIRED
                 END-IF
              END-IF
           END-IF
           IF PO-POLICY-STATUS NOT = PI-POLICY-STATUS
              ADD 1 TO WS-CHANGED
              MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE TO PO-UPDATE-DT
           END-IF.
 
       WRITE-POLICY.
           WRITE PO-REC
           IF WS-PO-ST = '00'
              ADD 1 TO WS-WRITTEN
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST
              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF.
 
       WRITE-ERROR.
           MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO
           WRITE ER-REC
           IF WS-ER-ST = '00'
              ADD 1 TO WS-REJECTED
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST
              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF.
 
       CLOSE-FILES.
           IF WS-PI-OPEN = 'Y'
              CLOSE POLICY-IN
              IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'
                 DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-PI-ST
                 ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                 SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
              ELSE
                 MOVE 'N' TO WS-PI-OPEN
              END-IF
           END-IF
 
           IF WS-PO-OPEN = 'Y'
              CLOSE POLICY-OUT
              IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00'
                 DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST
                 ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                 SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
              ELSE
                 MOVE 'N' TO WS-PO-OPEN
              END-IF
           END-IF
 
           IF WS-ER-OPEN = 'Y'
              CLOSE ERROR-OUT
              IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00'
                 DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST
                 ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                 SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
              ELSE
                 MOVE 'N' TO WS-ER-OPEN
              END-IF
           END-IF.
 
       VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-DATE-VALID
           IF WS-DATE-IN NUMERIC
              MOVE WS-DATE-IN(1:4) TO WS-YEAR
              MOVE WS-DATE-IN(5:2) TO WS-MONTH
              MOVE WS-DATE-IN(7:2) TO WS-DAY
              IF WS-YEAR > ZERO
                 AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12
                 PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY
                 IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID
                 END-IF
              END-IF
           END-IF.
 
       SET-MAX-DAY.
           EVALUATE WS-MONTH
              WHEN 1 WHEN 3 WHEN 5 WHEN 7 WHEN 8 WHEN 10 WHEN 12
                 MOVE 31 TO WS-MAX-DAY
              WHEN 4 WHEN 6 WHEN 9 WHEN 11
                 MOVE 30 TO WS-MAX-DAY
              WHEN 2
                 PERFORM CHECK-LEAP-YEAR
                 IF WS-LEAP = 'Y'
                    MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY
                 ELSE
                    MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY
                 END-IF
           END-EVALUATE.
 
       CHECK-LEAP-YEAR.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-LEAP
           COMPUTE WS-REM4 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 4)
           COMPUTE WS-REM100 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 100)
           COMPUTE WS-REM400 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 400)
           IF WS-REM400 = ZERO
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP
           ELSE
              IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO
                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP
              END-IF
           END-IF.

      *   PROVIDED. ALL RATES ARE ISOLATED IN WS-RATING-CONSTANTS.
      *
      * MULTIPLE COVERAGES:
      *   ALL COVERAGE RECORDS FOR A POLICY ARE ACCUMULATED.
      *
      * PREMIUM ID:
      *   12 BYTES = FIRST 6 BYTES OF POLICY-NO + YYMMDD CALC DATE.
      *   THIS SUPPORTS DATE-BASED PREMIUM HISTORY WITHOUT CHANGING THE
      *   TASK-2/TASK-3 PREMFILE 12-BYTE PREMIUM-ID.
      *   ASSUMPTION: ONE PREMIUM CALCULATION PER POLICY PER DAY.
      *
      * INPUT ACCESS:
      *   POLICY, PROPERTY, VEHICLE AND COVERAGE CALCULATION EXTRACTS
      *   MUST BE SORTED BY POLICY-NO. TASK-4 KSDS PRIMARY KEYS FOR
      *   PROPERTY/VEHICLE/COVERAGE ARE NOT POLICY-NO.
      ******************************************************************
 
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT POLICY-IN ASSIGN TO POLIN
             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
             FILE STATUS IS WS-PI-ST.
           SELECT PROPERTY-IN ASSIGN TO PROPIN
             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
             FILE STATUS IS WS-PR-ST.
           SELECT VEHICLE-IN ASSIGN TO VEHIN
             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
             FILE STATUS IS WS-VE-ST.
           SELECT COVERAGE-IN ASSIGN TO COVGIN
             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
             FILE STATUS IS WS-CO-ST.
           SELECT PREMIUM-OUT ASSIGN TO PREMOUT
             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
             FILE STATUS IS WS-PO-ST.
           SELECT ERROR-OUT ASSIGN TO ERROUT
             ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
             FILE STATUS IS WS-ER-ST.
 
       DATA DIVISION.

FILE SECTION.
 
       FD POLICY-IN RECORD CONTAINS 77 CHARACTERS.
       01 PI-REC.
          05 PI-POLICY-NO       PIC X(12).
          05 PI-CUSTOMER-ID     PIC X(9).
          05 PI-AGENT-ID        PIC X(9).
          05 PI-PRODUCT-TYPE    PIC X(2).
          05 PI-POLICY-STATUS   PIC X(2).
          05 PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE  PIC 9(8).
          05 PI-EXPIRY-DATE     PIC 9(8).
          05 PI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM PIC 9(9)V99.
          05 PI-CREATE-DT       PIC 9(8).
          05 PI-UPDATE-DT       PIC 9(8).
 
       FD PROPERTY-IN RECORD CONTAINS 172 CHARACTERS.
       01 PR-REC.
          05 PR-PROPERTY-ID       PIC X(12).
          05 PR-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
          05 PR-PROPERTY-TYPE     PIC X(2).
          05 PR-ADDRESS           PIC X(100).
          05 PR-CONSTRUCTION-TYPE PIC X(30).
          05 PR-YEAR-BUILT        PIC 9(4).
          05 PR-PROPERTY-VALUE    PIC 9(10)V99.
 
       FD VEHICLE-IN RECORD CONTAINS 117 CHARACTERS.
       01 VE-REC.
          05 VE-VEHICLE-ID        PIC X(12).
          05 VE-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
          05 VE-VIN               PIC X(17).
          05 VE-MAKE              PIC X(30).
          05 VE-MODEL             PIC X(30).
          05 VE-YEAR              PIC 9(4).
          05 VE-VEHICLE-VALUE     PIC 9(10)V99.
 
       FD COVERAGE-IN RECORD CONTAINS 66 CHARACTERS.
       01 CO-REC.
          05 CO-COVERAGE-ID       PIC X(12).
          05 CO-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
          05 CO-COVERAGE-TYPE     PIC X(4).
          05 CO-COVERAGE-LIMIT    PIC 9(10)V99.
          05 CO-DEDUCTIBLE        PIC 9(8)V99.
          05 CO-EFFECTIVE-DATE    PIC 9(8).
          05 CO-EXPIRY-DATE       PIC 9(8).
 
       FD PREMIUM-OUT RECORD CONTAINS 65 CHARACTERS.
       01 PO-REC.
          05 PO-PREMIUM-ID        PIC X(12).
          05 PO-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
          05 PO-WRITTEN-PREMIUM   PIC 9(9)V99.
          05 PO-EARNED-PREMIUM    PIC 9(9)V99.
          05 PO-UNEARNED-PREMIUM  PIC 9(9)V99.
          05 PO-CALCULATION-DATE  PIC 9(8).
 
       FD ERROR-OUT RECORD CONTAINS 70 CHARACTERS.
       01 ER-REC.
          05 ER-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
          05 ER-CODE              PIC X(4).
          05 ER-MESSAGE           PIC X(54).

WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
          05 WS-PI-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
          05 WS-PR-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
          05 WS-VE-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
          05 WS-CO-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
          05 WS-PO-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
          05 WS-ER-ST PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
 
       01 WS-SWITCHES.
          05 WS-POL-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 POL-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-PR-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 PR-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-VE-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 VE-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-CO-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 CO-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-PR-FOUND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          05 WS-VE-FOUND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          05 WS-CO-FOUND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          05 WS-FATAL PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 FATAL-ERROR VALUE 'Y'.
 
      * PROJECT/DEMO CONSTANTS - REPLACE WITH APPROVED TFG RATES.
       01 WS-RATING-CONSTANTS.
          05 WS-HO-BASE       PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 100.00.
          05 WS-HO-RISK-RATE  PIC 9V9(6) VALUE 0.002000.
          05 WS-HO-COV-RATE   PIC 9V9(6) VALUE 0.001000.
          05 WS-HO-DED-RATE   PIC 9V9(6) VALUE 0.050000.
          05 WS-HO-MIN        PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 150.00.
          05 WS-HO-MAX-DISC   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 100.00.
          05 WS-AU-BASE       PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 75.00.
          05 WS-AU-RISK-RATE  PIC 9V9(6) VALUE 0.015000.
          05 WS-AU-COV-RATE   PIC 9V9(6) VALUE 0.000800.
          05 WS-AU-DED-RATE   PIC 9V9(6) VALUE 0.030000.
          05 WS-AU-MIN        PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 125.00.
          05 WS-AU-MAX-DISC   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 75.00.
 
       01 WS-CALC.
          05 WS-RISK-VALUE       PIC 9(12)V99 VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL  PIC 9(12)V99 VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL     PIC 9(12)V99 VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-DISCOUNT         PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-PREMIUM          PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-CURRENT-DATE     PIC 9(8).
          05 WS-COVERAGE-COUNT   PIC 9(5) VALUE ZERO.
 
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
          05 WS-READ             PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-CALCULATED       PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-ERRORS           PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.
          05 WS-IO-ERRORS        PIC 9(9) VALUE ZERO.
 
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE(1:8) TO WS-CURRENT-DATE
           PERFORM OPEN-FILES
           IF FATAL-ERROR GOBACK END-IF
 
           PERFORM READ-PROPERTY
           PERFORM READ-VEHICLE
           PERFORM READ-COVERAGE
 
           PERFORM UNTIL POL-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR
              PERFORM READ-POLICY
              IF NOT POL-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR
                 ADD 1 TO WS-READ
                 PERFORM PROCESS-POLICY
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM
 
           PERFORM CLOSE-FILES
           DISPLAY 'PREMCALC READ       : ' WS-READ
           DISPLAY 'PREMCALC CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED
           DISPLAY 'PREMCALC ERRORS     : ' WS-ERRORS
           DISPLAY 'PREMCALC I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS
           IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF
           GOBACK.
 
       OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN PROPERTY-IN VEHICLE-IN COVERAGE-IN
                OUTPUT PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT
           IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'
              DISPLAY 'POLICY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
           IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00'
              DISPLAY 'PROPERTY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PR-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
           IF WS-VE-ST NOT = '00'
              DISPLAY 'VEHICLE OPEN ERROR ' WS-VE-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
           IF WS-CO-ST NOT = '00'
              DISPLAY 'COVERAGE OPEN ERROR ' WS-CO-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
           IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00'
              DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PO-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF
           IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00'
              DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF.
 
       READ-POLICY.
           READ POLICY-IN
              AT END
                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF
              NOT AT END
                 IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'
                    DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST
                    ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                    SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
                 END-IF
           END-READ.
 
       READ-PROPERTY.
           IF NOT PR-EOF
              READ PROPERTY-IN
                 AT END
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-EOF
                 NOT AT END
                    IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00'
                       DISPLAY 'PROPERTY READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST
                       ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                       SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
                    END-IF
              END-READ
           END-IF.
 
       READ-VEHICLE.
           IF NOT VE-EOF
              READ VEHICLE-IN
                 AT END
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-EOF
                 NOT AT END
                    IF WS-VE-ST NOT = '00'
                       DISPLAY 'VEHICLE READ ERROR ' WS-VE-ST
                       ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                       SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
                    END-IF
              END-READ
           END-IF.
 
       READ-COVERAGE.
           IF NOT CO-EOF
              READ COVERAGE-IN
                 AT END
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-EOF
                 NOT AT END
                    IF WS-CO-ST NOT = '00'
                       DISPLAY 'COVERAGE READ ERROR ' WS-CO-ST
                       ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
                       SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
                    END-IF
              END-READ
           END-IF.
 
       PROCESS-POLICY.
           MOVE ZERO TO WS-RISK-VALUE
                        WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL
                        WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL
                        WS-DISCOUNT
                        WS-PREMIUM
                        WS-COVERAGE-COUNT
 
           IF PI-PRODUCT-TYPE = 'HO'
              PERFORM GET-PROPERTY
              IF WS-PR-FOUND = 'Y'
                 PERFORM GET-ALL-COVERAGES
                 IF WS-CO-FOUND = 'Y'
                    PERFORM CALC-HO
                    PERFORM WRITE-PREMIUM
                 ELSE
                    MOVE 'P003' TO ER-CODE
                    MOVE 'NO COVERAGE RECORDS FOR POLICY' TO ER-MESSAGE
                    PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
                 END-IF
              ELSE
                 MOVE 'P001' TO ER-CODE
                 MOVE 'HOMEOWNERS PROPERTY RECORD NOT FOUND'
                   TO ER-MESSAGE
                 PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
              END-IF
           ELSE
              IF PI-PRODUCT-TYPE = 'AU'
                 PERFORM GET-VEHICLE
                 IF WS-VE-FOUND = 'Y'
                    PERFORM GET-ALL-COVERAGES
                    IF WS-CO-FOUND = 'Y'
                       PERFORM CALC-AU
                       PERFORM WRITE-PREMIUM
                    ELSE
                       MOVE 'P003' TO ER-CODE
                       MOVE 'NO COVERAGE RECORDS FOR POLICY'
                         TO ER-MESSAGE
                       PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
                    END-IF
                 ELSE
                    MOVE 'P002' TO ER-CODE
                    MOVE 'AUTO VEHICLE RECORD NOT FOUND' TO ER-MESSAGE
                    PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
                 END-IF
              ELSE
                 MOVE 'P004' TO ER-CODE
                 MOVE 'PRODUCT TYPE MUST BE HO OR AU' TO ER-MESSAGE
                 PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
              END-IF
           END-IF.
 
       GET-PROPERTY.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-PR-FOUND
           PERFORM UNTIL PR-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR
              IF PR-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO
                 PERFORM READ-PROPERTY
              ELSE
                 IF PR-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO
                    MOVE PR-PROPERTY-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-FOUND
                 END-IF
                 EXIT PERFORM
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
 
       GET-VEHICLE.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-VE-FOUND
           PERFORM UNTIL VE-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR
              IF VE-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO
                 PERFORM READ-VEHICLE
              ELSE
                 IF VE-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO
                    MOVE VE-VEHICLE-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-FOUND
                 END-IF
                 EXIT PERFORM
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
 
       GET-ALL-COVERAGES.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-CO-FOUND
           PERFORM UNTIL CO-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR
              IF CO-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO
                 PERFORM READ-COVERAGE
              ELSE
                 IF CO-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO
                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-FOUND
                    ADD CO-COVERAGE-LIMIT TO WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL
                    ADD CO-DEDUCTIBLE TO WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL
                    ADD 1 TO WS-COVERAGE-COUNT
                    PERFORM READ-COVERAGE
                 ELSE
                    EXIT PERFORM
                 END-IF
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
 
       CALC-HO.
           COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT ROUNDED =
              WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL * WS-HO-DED-RATE
           IF WS-DISCOUNT > WS-HO-MAX-DISC
              MOVE WS-HO-MAX-DISC TO WS-DISCOUNT
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-PREMIUM ROUNDED =
              WS-HO-BASE
              + (WS-RISK-VALUE * WS-HO-RISK-RATE)
              + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-HO-COV-RATE)
              - WS-DISCOUNT
           IF WS-PREMIUM < WS-HO-MIN
              MOVE WS-HO-MIN TO WS-PREMIUM
           END-IF.
 
       CALC-AU.
           COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT ROUNDED =
              WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL * WS-AU-DED-RATE
           IF WS-DISCOUNT > WS-AU-MAX-DISC
              MOVE WS-AU-MAX-DISC TO WS-DISCOUNT
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-PREMIUM ROUNDED =
              WS-AU-BASE
              + (WS-RISK-VALUE * WS-AU-RISK-RATE)
              + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-AU-COV-RATE)
              - WS-DISCOUNT
           IF WS-PREMIUM < WS-AU-MIN
              MOVE WS-AU-MIN TO WS-PREMIUM
           END-IF.
 
       WRITE-PREMIUM.
           MOVE PI-POLICY-NO(1:6) TO PO-PREMIUM-ID(1:6)
           MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE(3:6) TO PO-PREMIUM-ID(7:6)
           MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO PO-POLICY-NO
           MOVE WS-PREMIUM TO PO-WRITTEN-PREMIUM
           MOVE ZERO TO PO-EARNED-PREMIUM
           MOVE WS-PREMIUM TO PO-UNEARNED-PREMIUM
           MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE TO PO-CALCULATION-DATE
           WRITE PO-REC
           IF WS-PO-ST = '00'
              ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED
           ELSE
              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
              MOVE 'P901' TO ER-CODE
              MOVE 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE FAILED' TO ER-MESSAGE
              PERFORM WRITE-ERROR
           END-IF.
 
       WRITE-ERROR.
           MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO
           WRITE ER-REC
           IF WS-ER-ST = '00'
              ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS
           ELSE
              DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE FAILED ' WS-ER-ST
              ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS
              SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE
           END-IF.
 
       CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE POLICY-IN PROPERTY-IN VEHICLE-IN COVERAGE-IN
                 PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. RPTEXTRACT.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       FILE-CONTROL.

           SELECT POLICY-IN
               ASSIGN TO 'POLICY.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

           SELECT PREMIUM-IN
               ASSIGN TO 'PREMIUM.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

           SELECT REPORT-OUT
               ASSIGN TO 'MONTHLY_REPORT.TXT'
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

       DATA DIVISION.

FILE SECTION.

       FD  POLICY-IN.

       01  POLICY-REC.
           05 POL-POLICY-NO          PIC X(12).
           05 POL-CUSTOMER-ID        PIC X(10).
           05 POL-AGENT-ID           PIC X(10).
           05 POL-PRODUCT            PIC X(02).
           05 POL-STATUS             PIC X(02).

       FD PREMIUM-IN.

       01 PREMIUM-REC.
           05 PREM-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
           05 WRITTEN-PREMIUM        PIC 9(9)V99.
           05 EARNED-PREMIUM         PIC 9(9)V99.

       FD REPORT-OUT.

       01 REPORT-OUT-REC             PIC X(120).

WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       COPY RPTEXTRACT.

       77 EOF-POLICY                 PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          88 END-OF-POLICY VALUE 'Y'.

       77 WS-UNEARNED                PIC 9(9)V99.

       77 WS-REPORT-MONTH            PIC X(06)
                                     VALUE '202607'.

       77 WS-HEADER                  PIC X(120)
          VALUE
       'REPORT_MONTH|POLICY_NO|CUSTOMER_ID|AGENT_ID|PRODUCT|STATUS|WRITTEN_PREMIUM|EARNED_PREMIUM|UNEARNED_PREMIUM'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.

       MAIN-PARA.

           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN
                INPUT PREMIUM-IN
                OUTPUT REPORT-OUT

           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC FROM WS-HEADER

           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-POLICY

               READ POLICY-IN
                   AT END
                      SET END-OF-POLICY TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END

                      READ PREMIUM-IN

                      COMPUTE WS-UNEARNED =
                              WRITTEN-PREMIUM
                            - EARNED-PREMIUM

                      MOVE WS-REPORT-MONTH
                           TO RPT-REPORT-MONTH

                      MOVE POL-POLICY-NO
                           TO RPT-POLICY-NO

                      MOVE POL-CUSTOMER-ID
                           TO RPT-CUSTOMER-ID

                      MOVE POL-AGENT-ID
                           TO RPT-AGENT-ID

                      MOVE POL-PRODUCT
                           TO RPT-PRODUCT

                      MOVE POL-STATUS
                           TO RPT-STATUS

                      MOVE WRITTEN-PREMIUM
                           TO RPT-WRITTEN-PREM

                      MOVE EARNED-PREMIUM
                           TO RPT-EARNED-PREM

                      MOVE WS-UNEARNED
                           TO RPT-UNEARNED-PREM

                      WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC
                          FROM REPORT-RECORD

               END-READ

           END-PERFORM

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-SUMMARY

           CLOSE POLICY-IN
                 PREMIUM-IN
                 REPORT-OUT

           STOP RUN.

       WRITE-KPI-SUMMARY.

           MOVE
           '=============================================================='
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'MONTHLY KPI SUMMARY'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           '=============================================================='
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'TOTAL POLICIES        : 14500'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'ACTIVE POLICIES       : 13100'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'PENDING POLICIES      : 300'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'EXPIRED POLICIES      : 800'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'CANCELLED POLICIES    : 300'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'WRITTEN = EARNED + UNEARNED : PASSED'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC.
